criteria.name: hook_strength
criteria.description: The first 3 seconds must make the viewer stop scrolling.

criteria.name: mainstream_convention
criteria.description: Follows the most universally accepted editing style of actual popular Shorts/Reels: proven cut rhythm, caption placement, and structure. Safe and broadly appealing beats experimental or niche choices.

criteria.name: instruction_fit
criteria.description: Faithfully realizes the user's free-form request (caption tone, effects, mood). Ignore this criterion (redistribute judgment) when no request was given.

criteria.name: pacing
criteria.description: Rhythmic cuts, no dead air, energy rises toward the payoff.

criteria.name: narrative_clarity
criteria.description: One clear thread from hook to payoff; no confusing jumps.

criteria.name: moment_selection
criteria.description: The genuinely best raw moments were used, not filler.

notes: Seed rubric. Baseline = the most universal, safe mainstream shorts editing style, as seen in actual popular shorts. Refined continuously from the pilot creator's evaluations.
